To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Reproductive aging in the female rat is associated with age-related changes in anterior pituitary gene regulation.
pituitary gene transcription of gonadotropins and their receptors is altered in aged females, and that this may contribute to the age-related loss of fertility.

the pituitary of middle-aged female rats is less responsive than the pituitary in young rats to the stimulatory effects of gonadotropins on the expression of genes encoding the gonadotrophs themselves, as well as the genes encoding activins and follistatin.
